items.title: Ken Peplowski interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: And Dick is a wonderful clarinet player and a very nice guy too.

ctx.x: He lives in Boston. In fact the ironic thing is Dick used to play in Buddy Morrow’s band in the early 1950s. And Dick is a wonderful clarinet player and a very nice guy too. And he’s a man you might want to talk to, he’s an interesting guy. But he did a lot for me. So that was my big job experience. And then moving to New York after that, you know I was scared to death. I didn’t know anybody and I was there about six months before I even got any work. Oh in between that I did eight months on the road with…
Like this show is so squeaky clean, we’re going to go the other way.
